blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Suggested edits
blocks.body:
**Track Changes** is a mode that records insertions and deletions so you can accept or reject them. **Review view** lists those edits and your **comments**.

Turn it on. Edit. Comment. Accept or reject with intent. Then turn it off.

This desk uses this panel. One file, one place for comments.

If you type over a reused warning while tracking is on, you may replace a pointer with a copy. Check Text if the “edit” looks too smooth.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Track Changes was off so the edit vanished into the source, or you accepted everything without reading, or you replaced a warning pointer with a copied sentence.

Expected: Review view shows the leftover comment (or a resolved thread you recorded). One accept, one reject. File clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open prime-the-pump.dita. Turn on Track Changes (Review toolbar :  verify the label).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Edit one step (an insertion). Delete a word in the context line (a deletion). Add a comment on the warning: confirm the pinch warning still belongs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Open Review view. You should see insertion, deletion, and comment.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Accept the insertion. Reject the deletion. Leave the comment for a teammate :  or resolve it if your version uses resolve. Write which you did.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Turn Track Changes off before you tidy anything else.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Do not type the warning sentence over a name pointer and call it an edit.

blocks.summary: Review view shows the leftover comment (or a resolved thread you recorded). One accept, one reject. File clean.

options: You may have replaced a pointer with a copy, and the suggested edit hides that
Nothing :  a pointer cannot be edited
blocks.why: Glance at Text if a change looks like ordinary typing on reused content.

blocks.q: Review view records insertions, deletions, and comments. Where is that view?
options: Oxygen’s Review view (right side or Window menu :  verify the label)
blocks.why: Suggested edits live in Review view, not in the version dialog and not in completeness.
